name: neoting
description: Neoting — chat-first document-to-bookkeeping platform. See docs/Source_Of_Truth.md
//prisma: Declared at the ROOT, not in apps/api. The Prisma CLI resolves .env relative to its working directory, and .env lives here — running it from apps/api silently loses DATABASE_URL and DIRECT_URL, which surfaces as 'Environment variable not found' rather than anything about the working directory.

scripts.db:reset: prisma migrate reset --force --skip-seed && pnpm db:app-role && pnpm db:seed
scripts.db:app-role: docker exec -i nt-postgres psql -U neoting -d neoting -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q < prisma/sql/app-role.sql
scripts.db:tenancy-check: docker exec -i nt-postgres psql -U neoting -d neoting -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q < prisma/sql/tenancy-check.sql
scripts.pr:title: node scripts/check-pr-title.mjs
